title: The AI app that makes you  a day while you sleep

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: If an AI app could let you live a full day while you sleep, what would that mean for our time, our work, and our humanity?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Current sleep tech can track brain waves, but creating a full simulated day would need VR, neural interfaces, and real-time AI-generated experiences.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: This could deepen isolation, blur reality, and erode social bonds if people opt out of real-life interactions for synthetic ones.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Engineers are prioritizing safety protocols, user control, and integration with real-world responsibilities to prevent over-reliance.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: In the future, such apps might help people experience diverse cultures or careers without leaving their homes, enriching empathy and learning.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of sleep may redefine how we experience life — not as a replacement, but as an expansion of our human potential.

video_cue: A person wearing a neural interface headset, surrounded by holographic environments that shift as they sleep.
